context: A doctor explains public health to a teen
purpose: Teach: 分布/良心/防御/加害/捜索/河川/大震災/楽観

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 桜さん、感染症の分布、河川沿いの集落に注目してる。
lines.en: Sakura, I'm seeing a cluster of infectious-disease cases concentrated along the river settlements.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Direct eye contact. Calm authority without coldness. The tone of someone who has delivered difficult information many times and does it clearly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 住民の良心に頼るだけじゃ、防御は弱いですね。
lines.en: Just relying on residents' own good judgment won't be enough protection, will it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost asking-aloud. Not challenging — working through the problem alongside her. Quiet recognition of a gap between ideal and reality.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。大震災後の保健ネットワーク、再構築中です。
lines.en: That's right. The health network from after the earthquake is still in the middle of being rebuilt.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Brief pause before 「健康ネットワーク」 — acknowledging the weight of that work. Clear but not rushed. The patience of someone explaining something difficult to someone worth taking time for.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 加害源を、まだ捜索中なんですね。
lines.en: So we're still searching for the source of this.
lines.style: Quiet realization settling in. Not defeated — analytical. The voice of someone piecing something together and not quite liking where it leads. Slight trailing pause.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 楽観してはいけない。地味な地道さが要る。
lines.en: We can't afford to be optimistic. We need steady, unglamorous work.
lines.style: Firmer now. Weight on 「楽観」 — a quiet warning. Not harsh, but clear. The voice of experience speaking to someone she respects. Close with conviction but without drama.
